final_message:
Configured the internal DNS hierarchy with the requested host names and MX records. All 20 PCs use the resolver on **pc18**; existing connections, addresses and routes remain unchanged.

The authoritative servers are pc1 (root), pc2 (`com`), pc3 (`net`), pc10 (`example.com`), pc14 (`service.com`), pc15 (`lab.net`), pc16 (`tools.net`) and pc17 (`research.lab.net`). The existing `kathara/base` images already include BIND.

I checked the generated configuration statically. BIND’s validation tools were unavailable locally, and the lab was not started, so resolution and connectivity still need runtime verification. The MX records identify the mail hosts; they do not configure mail delivery services.
